name: async-pr-review
title_zh: 后台挂起 PR 审查，干别的回来再看结果
tagline_zh: 不用守着终端等审查跑完。发起异步 PR 审查、跑后台检查、随时查进度，三件事一个入口。
tagline_en: Kick off a PR review and walk away. Start async reviews, run background checks, and poll status anytime. Built.
desc_en: Trigger this skill when the user wants to start an asynchronous PR review, run background checks on a PR, or check the status of a previously started async PR review.
why_zh: 把审查从阻塞式对话里拆出来，变成可查询的后台任务。不占着你的交互窗口，状态可随时拉取。
why_en: Decouples review from blocking chat by turning it into a queryable background job. Frees your session, lets you poll.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 GitHub PR 的异步审查启动与状态查询；不处理行内评论、合并操作或审查结果自动落地。
limit_en: Only starts async GitHub PR reviews and checks their status. No inline comments, merging, or auto-applying results. Requires logged-in gemini-cli.
title_en: Start a PR review in background, check status later
